- Primary success criteria: sub-200ms 95th percentile response time, < $0.003 per generated KB, and no PII leakage.
- Expected initial scope: 5 storefront locales, ~200k monthly queries.

2) Asks / open items:
- Can you share a short org chart (or list of decision owners) for procurement, security, and the business sponsor?
- Who is the economic buyer for this initiative (responsible for purchase sign-off)?
- Any compliance or data residency requirements we should be mindful of?

3) Next steps (proposed):
- You to share org chart / security contact (you mentioned Carlos and Tanya on the call) - action: Julia
- Redwood to send a short mutual action plan & SOW template - action: Marissa (target: EOD Monday)
- Quick tech follow-up w/ Marcus to scope integration and SSO - action: Marcus (schedule next week)

I attached the short demo recording and will follow up with a one-page mutual action plan after this email. If you can drop the names/emails for procurement and security (or introduce us), that will help us prepare the right materials.

Thanks - looking forward to moving this to procurement discussions.
